name: HD Audio sound driver (WDMHDA)
description: Sound on the HD Audio ('Azalia') chips almost every PC since 2005 has, through WDMHDA 0.26 by Andrew Hoffman (MIT, https://github.com/andrew-hoffman/wdmhda): a generic controller and codec driver, playback only, up to 48 kHz 16-bit stereo. Works with Intel, AMD, NVIDIA and VIA controllers with Realtek and VIA codecs; IDT, Analog Devices and Cirrus Logic codecs aren't well supported yet. DOS games get Sound Blaster emulation from Windows' own SBEMUL.

ops.comment: The setup folder is Windows' source path: the driver installs with no disk prompt, and Windows' own kernel-streaming files come from the same place.
